items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve got a lot of them that was done by Andrew White in Washington [D.C.], and I marveled at them... I’ve looked at it, of course.

ctx.x: Well, do you have any of his transcribed solos that you ever looked at?

Yes, I’ve got a lot of them that was done by Andrew White in Washington [D.C.], and I marveled at them, because I don’t know how he did all of this, you know. No, I’ve never tried to play any of that. I’ve looked at it, of course.
The statement that prompted all of this . . .
